gates.title: Scope và nguồn
gates.pass_requirement: Same approved namespace/company/plant/period/cutoff, source_kind và variant; đầy đủ D01–D10/D16/SUP01 hoặc documented applicable subset
gates.negative_evidence: Cố trộn client/period/profile phải BLOCK; no invented sample approval

gates.title: RAW bất biến
gates.pass_requirement: Upload/download SHA-256 giống; tamper denied hoặc detected; bytes/headers/layout nguyên bản; new run không overwrite
gates.negative_evidence: Sửa byte/hash mismatch chặn toàn run; hash một mình không đủ proof write-once

gates.title: Adapter và DQ
gates.pass_requirement: Required fields typed; zero silent row loss; counts conservation; malformed/leading-zero/locale/duplicate corpus có expected outcomes
gates.negative_evidence: Missing numeric không biến 0; truncated export, ambiguous header phải block

gates.title: COOIS ↔ MB51 consumption
gates.pass_requirement: C01 material-doc identity + C02 net 261/262, reservation mapping/cutoff/UoM đúng; ambiguity rõ
gates.negative_evidence: Same component lặp, reversal khác kỳ, missing conversion không false-match

gates.title: Header ↔ GR
gates.pass_requirement: C03 delivered snapshot ↔ cumulative 101/102 with opening and output scope
gates.negative_evidence: Partial output/by-product/cross-period không bị cộng sai; unexplained diff chặn

gates.title: KOB1 ↔ KKS1
gates.pass_requirement: C04 classified cost bridge cùng currency/target version; all differences explained by source evidence
gates.negative_evidence: Không dùng sum KOB1=variance; thiếu WIP/overhead basis phải BLOCKED

gates.title: KKS1/settlement ↔ GL
gates.pass_requirement: C05 includes SUP01 settlement receiver/reference bridge and GL view mapping; balanced financial basis
gates.negative_evidence: Thiếu link hoặc lặp settlement không PASS; production vs sales-order policy tách

gates.title: CK13N standard-cost drill
gates.pass_requirement: C06 header/itemization same estimate/lot/version/currency/cost view; additive leaves only
gates.negative_evidence: Zero lot size/mixed versions/parent subtotals đều bắt được

gates.title: Variance và commentary
gates.pass_requirement: C07 explicit residual; C08 every numeric assertion traceable to approved mart; fact vs hypothesis; AI failure safe
gates.negative_evidence: Residual không bằng chứng nguyên nhân; commentary chặn failed inputs

gates.title: Independent release
gates.pass_requirement: No self-approval; reproducible evidence; regression/security/performance/restore + release human signoff
gates.negative_evidence: Repeated upload/replay/concurrent run no double count; rollback rehearsal
